newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia passenger car sales 26,440 units in Jan.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia passenger car sales 26,440 units in Jan.

text.p: Malaysia's passenger car sales, including four-wheel-drive vehicles for private use, totalled 26,440 units in January from 19,189 in January last year, the Malaysian Motor Traders' Association (MMTA) said on Wednesday.
Commercial vehicle sales, including four-by-four vehicles used for business, totalled 8,442 units against 5,771 in January 1996.
On a month-to-month basis, January's passenger car sales of 26,440 units was lower than 29,578 units in December 1996.
Commercial vehicles sold in January was also lower than December's 8,862.
The locally-made Proton remained the best-selling car, with 9,860 units sold in January, up from 9,385 units in the same month a year ago, but down from December's 14,460.
